text: The owners of The Opera House, located at 735 Queen Street East, contacted my office about illegally parked vehicles on Lewis Street, between Queen Street E and June Callwood Way. The Opera House is a concert and event venue that often has buses stopped on the west side of Lewis Street. The Opera House has let my office know that vehicles are parking on the east side of Lewis Street in the no parking zone which causes congestion when buses are simultaneously parked. The recommendations in this letter strive to keep this street clear of illegally parked vehicles by changing this no parking zone to a no stopping zone

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the both sides of Lewis Street, between Queen Street East and a point 40.2 metres south. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east side of Lewis Street, between Queen Street East and June Callwood Way. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Lewis Street, between Queen Street East and a point 20 metres south.
